items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: Valmo and I were classmates. And he played the piano for the groups to sing. A boy named Hannibal played the violin. The two grand brothers, one played violin and the other played clarinet. And we had a little group that would play for little afternoon class parties.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I heard of him.

He was in that group. And many of the musicians who were playing with some big bands away from here now, they started under him as a teacher. Valmo and I were classmates. And he played the piano for the groups to sing. A boy named Hannibal played the violin. The two grand brothers, one played violin and the other played clarinet. And we had a little group that would play for little afternoon class parties. And I had my banjo. And we thought that we were something with that group that we had. But I always said…
He taught the music then in the schools too?
